By virtue of the authority vested in  
me by section 4 of the Air Commerce  
Act of 1926 (44 Stat. 570), the airspace  
above the following-described portion of  
the United States is hereby reserved and  
set apart for national defense and other  
governmental purposes as an airspace  
reservation within which no person shall  
navigate an aircraft except by authority  
of the United States Atomic Energy  
Commission!
All that area within the United States  
lying within the following-described  
boundaries:
L as V egas P r o ject, L as V egas, N evada
Beginning at Lat. 37°17'00'', long. 
115°45'00''; thence due south to Lat.
